title: The Tool Interface — Why Agents Need Structured I/O

questions.question: In the lesson registry, which input is required by get_weather?
options: city (units defaults to celsius)
timezone is required and city is inferred from it
a and b are required numeric operands
get_weather accepts no arguments
questions.explanation: The weather schema requires city and gives units a default of celsius, with celsius and fahrenheit as its allowed values.

questions.question: What does fake_decide route for the request 'please add 7 and 35'?
options: A final message saying the sum was not requested
An add tool call with a=7 and b=35
A get_time call using UTC
A get_weather call for city 7
questions.explanation: The add/sum/plus branch extracts the first two numbers and creates one add call with those operands.

questions.question: What does validate return for the add schema and the value {a: 2}?
options: valid, because b defaults to zero
a type error for a
missing required field 'b'
an enum error for the absent units field
questions.explanation: Both a and b are required by the add schema, so omitting b produces the missing-field message.

questions.question: What temperature does the fake weather tool use for an unknown city such as Oslo?
options: The Tokyo value, 12 degrees Celsius
A random temperature on every call
The Zurich value, 4 degrees Celsius
20 degrees Celsius
questions.explanation: The fake implementation has explicit values for four cities and returns 20 for any other city.

questions.question: After the add call finishes, what must the next agent turn be able to inspect?
options: role tool, matching call id, and serialized result
Only the original user text; tool results are discarded
A new system prompt containing the calculator source
The registry with the add schema removed
questions.explanation: run_loop appends the tool result to history with role tool and the matching call id, allowing the next decision to answer from the observation.

questions.question: What safety bound does run_loop enforce if an agent keeps requesting tools?
options: It retries forever until a tool returns JSON
It stops after MAX_TURNS, which is 5
It allows exactly one tool call per process
It stops only when the user sends another message
questions.explanation: MAX_TURNS is set to 5, so the loop has a finite circuit-breaker even when the model never produces a final answer.
